title: First-Decline Courtesy on Tailwise Plus Overdue Fees — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Courtesy.** On the overdue fee collected to reinstate a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, a first-decline courtesy — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted according to the declined-fee entries on the rewards history dated in the last 24 months.

| Declined-fee entries dated in the last 24 months | First-decline courtesy |
|---|---|
| exactly 1 | $2.00 |
| exactly 2 | $1.00 |
| none, or more than 2 | none |

**Counting.** Every declined-fee entry dated in the last 24 months is counted, including the one whose billing period is being paid.

**Examples (hypothetical).** A membership whose only decline in 24 months is the current one: $2.00. One earlier decline 11 months ago plus the current one: $1.00. Three declines in the window: none.
